whyItMatters: pickle.loads() on untrusted bytes can instantiate arbitrary objects and execute code during deserialization — data becomes execution.
actions: Stop unpickling untrusted bytes; switch to JSON with schema validation.
If pickle must cross a trust boundary, sign the payload and verify the signature before loading.
Re-run a SAST scan and confirm DPK-SAST-005 is no longer observed.
verification: The finding disappears on rescan and no pickle.loads call remains on untrusted input.

example.caveat: Validate the decoded JSON against a schema — safe parsing does not mean safe values.
